items.html: This is the meaning of “A virtuous woman is a crown to her husband.” In the end of days, she will be greater than the sun, and this is the meaning of “became the chief corner-stone.”When Malchut appears below, she appears from that Reisha de Lo Etyada. This matter will clarify for you how every Behinat Malchut of the Upper Olam herself becomes the Behinat Atik of the Olam below it. It turns out, that the nine Sefirot are of AA, and the Upper Reishade Lo Etyada above all, is the Behinat Atik.
